subtitle: Lesson 11 · Relationship Queries

eyebrow: A subquery inside the SELECT list
code:
SELECT Name,
  (SELECT LastName FROM Contacts)
FROM Account

One Account record, with a nested
list of its Contact records
caption: No T-SQL equivalent — this is one genuinely SOQL-native shape.

code:
FROM Contacts   <- relationship name (plural)
FROM Contact    <- object name (fails here)

Custom relationship:
FROM Invoices__r   (ends in __r, not __c)
caption: __r marks a traversable relationship; __c marks a custom field or object.

code:
SELECT Name,
  (SELECT LastName, Title
   FROM Contacts
   WHERE Title = 'CEO'
   ORDER BY LastName)
FROM Account
WHERE BillingState = 'GA'
caption: Outer WHERE filters Accounts; inner WHERE filters Contacts within each one.
